description: This file defines the ShapeAlterationBuilder class used for configuring shape alterations, including binding, creation, display, processing, and placement in the OrchardCore display management system.

classes.name: ShapeAlterationBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for configuring shape alterations, including binding, creation, display, processing, and placement.

classes.name: ShapePlacementContext
classes.description: A context class providing information about shape placement, including shape type, display type, differentiator, zone shape, and source info.

methods.name: ShapeAlterationBuilder
methods.description: Constructor initializing the builder with feature info and shape type.

methods.name: From
methods.description: Sets the feature info for the shape alteration.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Adds a configuration action to the builder.

methods.name: BoundAs
methods.description: Defines a binding for the shape with a source and async delegate.

methods.name: OnCreating
methods.description: Registers an action or async function to execute when the shape is being created.

methods.name: OnCreated
methods.description: Registers an action or async function to execute after the shape is created.

methods.name: OnDisplaying
methods.description: Registers an action or async function to execute when the shape is displayed.

methods.name: OnProcessing
methods.description: Registers an action or async function to execute during shape processing.

methods.name: OnDisplayed
methods.description: Registers an action or async function to execute after the shape has been rendered.

methods.name: Placement
methods.description: Defines placement logic for the shape based on a function or predicate.

methods.name: Build
methods.description: Builds and returns a ShapeAlteration object with the configured settings.
